authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 548 explicitly gives Hindi dhanush both bow and rainbow; CDIAL 6726 dhanus gives Prakrit dhaṇu and regional bow forms. Survey dʰanus/dʰanūs/danu rainbow fits this family with final-sibilant retention/loss and aspiration/length notation preserved. The rainbow sense is primary-supported, not inferred merely from the English bow metaphor. Local Indo-Aryan transmission and learned influence remain unresolved. Exact response: dʰanūs.
